name: Oita

flag.description: Three red kanji 大 (ō) joined in a ring on a white field.
flag.symbolism: The three 大 stand for trust, work and friendship; joined hand in hand they form a rising sun.

hook: Oita's red ring on white is three 大 (ō) characters holding hands; Saitama's red ring is sixteen jewels.
trivia: Ōita has more hot spring sources than any other prefecture, many of them in Beppu and Yufuin.
Beppu's "hells" are boiling, colored hot springs meant for looking at, not bathing in.
